name_input: SCHUF SPECIALITY VALVES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
product_summary: Industrial speciality valves for severe-service process applications. Product line documented on the group website schuf.com (SchuF group, Germany): automatic recirculation valves, blow-down valves (continuous CBD, intermittent IBD, quick-action discontinuous, tandem), changeover valves, angle control valves for flashing/anti-cavitation service (models 74BS X-Flash, 74CS ToughFlash, 74KS Cage release, 74M MultiStage), in-line control valve model 72, HP choke valve 71ES, high-pressure shut-off 71KS, wafer control valve 76PC, 3/4/5-way and multi-way diverter valves, disc and piston bottom outlet valves, goggle valves, globe valves, lift plug valves (IsoPlug/SwitchPlug model 12), line blind valves (Cam-Set, Cam-Slide, Stacey), ManiFlow selector valve, spray rinse valves, sampling valves, in-tank shut-off valves (TESO). Applications: coal gasification, delayed coking, hydrocracking, heavy oil upgrading, HPAL/mineral ore, polymer and PTA production, offshore, vacuum distillation. Source: https://www.schuf.com/ (valve catalogue navigation, retrieved for this check).
role_hint: manufacturer (subsidiary/affiliate of the German SchuF group; group site lists manufacturing locations incl. an India site). No independent India-specific catalogue page could be retrieved, so the Indian entity's own manufacturing vs. sales/service scope is not directly corroborated.
comment: HS mapping: declared 848140 (safety/relief valves), 848180 (other taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances), 848190 (parts of valves) — all three are consistent with the documented product line. Control valves, choke valves, diverter valves, bottom outlet valves, goggle/globe/plug/line-blind/sampling valves fall under 848180; valve parts under 848190; the blow-down / automatic recirculation / relief-type functions are the plausible basis for 848140, though the catalogue does not label any product explicitly as a safety or relief valve — that single line is best treated as plausible but not individually corroborated. No HS line is contradicted, so no correction is required. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: the declared industry 'IT и электроника' is wrong — this is mechanical engineering / industrial valve manufacturing (heavy process equipment for oil & gas, refining, chemicals, mining). Recommend reclassifying the industry field to machinery/valve manufacturing. TRADER SIGNS: none found; the entity name and group affiliation point to a manufacturer, not a trader. PRODUCT LINES MISSING FROM DECLARATION: none apparent — the declared HS set covers the whole catalogue at HS-6 level. CAVEAT per project rule 5: the product list above is from the group's own website/catalogue, i.e. 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), so actual shipments of these goods by the Indian entity remain unverified. No registry, revenue or volume data researched per role scope.
